text.tspan: A cover carries changed middle sheets
The booklet describes a route for its own circulation, not an independently identified organization.
Two rows of staple holes mark the
Retained as the outside of the booklet
May not know about the change
Told how to pass the alteration onward
B > A: supplies cover / C > A: supplies altered middle / D > A: hands out the copy / A > E: gives copying instructions / E > C: further substitution urged
The clerk may be unaware. The instruction to alter another copy is not evidence that the reader has already done it.
